name: Themis G.R.E.N. Ltd
summary: Themis G.R.E.N. Ltd, an Israeli construction firm, manages the entire spectrum of real estate projects, from initial planning and development to construction and sales. The company operates both within Israel and internationally, focusing on developing residential housing and commercial spaces. Established in 1988, the company previously traded as B. Yair Building Corporation 1988 Ltd and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
